summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the AI optical photonics component node identifies two reference leaders with direct InP/800G/1.6T exposure, one high-purity contract manufacturing/platform exposure, and one smaller speculative platform attempting to route around native InP substrate constraints. The cleanest direct-exposure names are Coherent and Lumentum, but both are now large-cap/high-attention reference anchors. Fabrinet is a second-order but direct manufacturing beneficiary tied to optical communications/datacom volume. Aeluma is the underfollowed small-cap/speculative-shadow candidate because its III-V-on-large-diameter-silicon approach could matter if InP wafer/device capacity remains constrained, but commercial datacenter qualification evidence still needs verification. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around AI optical photonics chokepoints. The strongest underfollowed lane is upstream of transceiver brands: InP substrates, InP laser/detector capacity, photodiodes/TIAs, CW lasers, and alternative III-V-on-silicon manufacturing platforms. Lumentum is included as a reference capacity anchor for InP lasers/detectors. AXTI, MTSI, and ALMU are the discovery-lane candidates: AXTI maps most directly to scarce InP substrate supply; MTSI maps to 1.6T optical component chipsets including lasers, photodiodes and TIAs; ALMU is a small-cap/speculative platform candidate attempting to bypass native InP substrate constraints through large-diameter III-V-on-silicon manufacturing.
